technical.summary: Strong bullish technicals with multiple moving average crosses and volume spike, but weak ADX trend strength and overbought stochRSI conditions create moderate entry risk in neutral sector environment.

fundamental.summary: No actionable smart money signals detected; insider/institutional activity absent, government contracts and lobbying data unavailable, with earnings event 80 days out presenting elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (11/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is neutral with only minor sales; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (39.5), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinational earnings, with earnings event 80 days out adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross (EMA 9/21), Ichimoku TK cross-up, and 15x volume spike create textbook bullish technical setup with extreme fear sentiment (11/100) offering contrarian entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely unfavourable (VIX crisis at 39.5, flat yield curve, rising DXY), fundamental score is critically weak (3/10), stochRSI overbought signals pullback risk, and price is below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA with earnings binary risk 80 days out.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows bullish structure (golden cross, Ichimoku TK cross, 15x volume spike) with extreme fear sentiment (11/100) offering contrarian opportunity. However, macro headwinds and weak fundamentals warrant observation rather than immediate entry.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis levels (39.5) combined with flat yield curve recession signal and stochRSI overbought conditions create high probability of pullback before trend confirmation; earnings binary 80 days out adds uncompensated risk.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technicals bullish but fundamentals, macro, and risk assessment strongly bearish; debate winner (bear) reflects conflicting signals
